entry.text: Project#1: Integration Platform
Environment: ServiceNow & Logic Monitor
Role: Software Engineer
Overview: Bi-Directional integration project which allow third party monitoring tool. i.e. Logic
monitor to create and update the incident in ServiceNow and ServiceNow agent to resolve
and closed the ticket record from ServiceNow incident record.
Responsibilities:
• Designed and implemented integration between ServiceNow Incident module and Logic
Monitor tool for automated incident creation from Logic Monitor and updating the
record from both the sides.
• Developed Import set table and transform map to handle incident creation/updation via
Import Set API.
• Implemented event-driven architecture using Event Registry and Script Actions.
• Implemented outbound REST message to update record in Logic Monitor from
ServiceNow.
• Implemented Import Sets, Transform Maps, field mappings, transformation scripts,
business rules, script includes, REST Message, OAUTH 2.0.
